questions.text: 11 Here is a solid cylinder. The radius of the cylinder is 10 cm. The height of the cylinder is h cm. The volume of the cylinder is 5341 cm3. Work out the total surface area of the cylinder. Give your answer correct to the nearest whole number.
12 The region R, shown shaded in the diagram, is bounded by the y-axis and the straight lines with equations y = -x and 2x + 5y = 12. Write down the three inequalities that define R

13 The cumulative frequency table shows information about the heights, in centimetres, of 60 plants. 120<h<130 8, 120<h<140 35, 120<h<150 52, 120<h<160 58, 120<h<170 60. (a) On the grid, draw a cumulative frequency graph for this information. (b) Use your graph to find an estimate for the median. (c) Use your graph to find an estimate for the lower quartile. (d) Use your graph to find an estimate for the number of plants with a height greater than 155 cm
14 A, B, C and D are points on a circle, centre O. angle ACD = 43. (a)(i) Find the size of angle ABD (ii) Give a reason for your answer. (b) Find the size of the reflex angle AOD
15 Mina recorded the times taken, in minutes, by 11 people to complete a puzzle. 2 2 3 6 7 8 9 12 13 17 20. Find the interquartile range of these times.
16 m is directly proportional to r2. m = 180 when r = 6. Find a formula for m in terms of r
17 The functions f and g are such that f(x) = x2 - 5, g(x) = 2x + 1. Solve fg(x) = 2gf(x). Show clear algebraic working.
18 Here are two vectors. OA = (4, -3), BA = (-15, 8). (a) Find 2AO as a column vector. (b) Find OB as a column vector. (c) Calculate the magnitude of the vector BA
19 Make x the subject of y = (3x + 5)/(4 - 2x)

20 The diagram shows a solid shape. The solid shape is made by removing a cone from a hemisphere. The radius of the cone is x cm. The height of the cone is x cm. The radius of the hemisphere is 2x cm. The volume of the solid shape is 3645/8 pi cm3. Find the outer curved surface area of the solid shape. Give your answer correct to the nearest whole number.

21 Solve the simultaneous equations y2 = x2 + 7, y = 3x - 5. Show clear algebraic working.

23 A particle is moving along a straight line that passes through the fixed point O. The displacement, s metres, of the particle from O at time t seconds is given by s = 15t2 - t3 + 12. Find the maximum velocity of the particle where 0 < t < 11. Show clear algebraic working.

25 Here are the first four terms of an arithmetic series. (k + 2) (k + 5) (k + 8) (k + 11). The sum of the first 2n terms of the series is 4 times the sum of the first n terms of the series. Work out the numerical value of the 100th term of the series. Show your working clearly.
